review_notes: These caps are cosmetic prototypes only and do not alter the structural shell or approved glow-panel geometry.
TRI003 was a Gate 1 glow candidate but is intentionally opaque in Gate 8 and is valid for a mirror-cap trial.
Four representative source facets produce six planar caps because QUAD014 and QUAD008 each have a real diagonal bend and must be split into their two source triangles.
The 0.6 mm and 0.8 mm sets use the same 0.9 mm perimeter inset and 0.8 mm corner chamfer.
Print each plate with the future mirrored face on the smooth build plate. Do not add supports, ironing, or raised labels to that face.
A printed metallic or silk filament is not a mirror finish; every prototype still receives adhesive mirror film.
